question_plain: Please export the records of the work as it runs today, by role-type and by process, as of 31 October 2026, with no field that says who did the work.
question_original: The present state names the work and its roles but not how the time and the volume spread across them; the frame's outcomes rest on that.

asking_form.export_of: the records of the work in the case queues, by role-type and process

why_it_matters: The present state, and the next stage's reading of today's workload, need how the work runs today.
blocks: Design Brief section 5 (present state); the current-state activity profile
effect_of_answer: The activity profile states the share of time and the volume by role-type and process; without it the part reads no observation.

if_unanswered.cost: The activity profile reads no observation; the next stage reads today's workload from nothing in this release.

minimality_proof.why_unanswered: The articles name the parent only, not its subsidiaries or their owners.

suggested_seat.role_as_named: the company secretary, as the articles name the role
